title: C82: candidate upper bound 0.2519923410* from a joint degree-104 certificate built on #280 v3 and v4 (unrefereed)
body:
**Update, 5 November 2026: this PR now proposes C82 < 0.2519923410\*** (candidate, unrefereed). It replaces this PR's earlier rows: 0.252404806\*, which V. Patankar's PR #280 v3 (0.2520591386\*) had beaten; 0.2520179248\*, an earlier checkpoint of our round-6 search; and 0.2519964890\*, that search's final certificate. This version comes from a further search over the union of our round-6 factors and the public #280 v4 certificate, which ended after three rounds without gain.

**Comparison with #280.** We replayed the public #280 certificates with our own interval verifier: v3 gives B in [0.2520591385259548 ± 1.94·10⁻¹⁷], and v4 gives B in [0.25200797232842968 ± 9.19·10⁻¹⁸]. Both agree with #280's printed values (0.2520591386\* and 0.2520079724\*). The bound here is below both, and it is built on both: it uses factors from #280 v3 and v4. No global priority or optimality claim is made.

**What is new and what is reused.** The certificate has eight monic degree-104 denominators: two new in this search, three from our earlier round-6 search (already in this PR's previous version), and three from V. Patankar's #280 certificates (D11_5_0 from v3, and D11_12_0 and D31_5_0 from v4). All 18 numerators are existing public factors: Doche's P1, P2, P3, P4 and P6, MS360 from our PR #301, and twelve factors from #280 v3, v4 or #280's public numerator bank. The search re-solved the joint LP of PR #301 (reduced costs, residue-class restriction) over the union of these factor libraries, then added denominators with our reimplementation of V. Patankar's weighted-evaluation closest-vector method and re-solved the exact rational weights. Doche is credited for the limit-point construction, Grinsztajn and Épi for earlier factor libraries and methods, as on the live page. The packet's [README](https://github.com/rpinho/math-certificates/blob/a12c3622120c39af776902dbe49b6eff97a4d189/c82/degree104-joint/README.md) and [FACTOR_PROVENANCE.json](https://github.com/rpinho/math-certificates/blob/a12c3622120c39af776902dbe49b6eff97a4d189/c82/degree104-joint/FACTOR_PROVENANCE.json) give the origin of every factor by full coefficient comparison.

No Python from vidigoat/optimization-records is included, imported or run in this packet; [PYTHON_BLOBS.json](https://github.com/rpinho/math-certificates/blob/a12c3622120c39af776902dbe49b6eff97a4d189/c82/degree104-joint/PYTHON_BLOBS.json) compares every Python file against that repository's trees at 197962c, 3a7a84f and 79ce0df (no matches). The coefficient data from that MIT-licensed repository are listed in the [third-party notice](https://github.com/rpinho/math-certificates/blob/a12c3622120c39af776902dbe49b6eff97a4d189/c82/degree104-joint/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICE.md).

**Verification.** D = 999,999,999,856, a = deg A/b = 939550863051360379/1048576. The separately written interval verifier `verify_best.py` (standard library and python-flint only) checks integer coefficients, monic denominators, positive integer multiplicities, nonnegative rational exponents, the strict degree inequality and all 144 active numerator/denominator gcd pairs, isolates all 2224 composed roots with FLINT, and encloses B = H + J with Arb at 256 bits:

    0.2519923409720083869767 ≤ B ≤ 0.2519923409720083953971

The exact upper endpoint is below 0.2519923410 by about 2.80·10⁻¹¹. The fresh release run takes 40 seconds on one core ([receipt](https://github.com/rpinho/math-certificates/blob/a12c3622120c39af776902dbe49b6eff97a4d189/c82/degree104-joint/receipts/release-verifier.json), [REPRODUCE.md](https://github.com/rpinho/math-certificates/blob/a12c3622120c39af776902dbe49b6eff97a4d189/c82/degree104-joint/REPRODUCE.md)). The mathematical reduction is Doche's limit-point argument (C. Doche, [“Zhang-Zagier heights of perturbed polynomials”](https://www.numdam.org/item/JTNB_2001__13_1_103_0/), J. Théor. Nombres Bordeaux 13 (2001), 103–110), with the extraction step written out in the [proof](https://github.com/rpinho/math-certificates/blob/a12c3622120c39af776902dbe49b6eff97a4d189/c82/degree104-joint/PROOF.md); it remains a mathematical argument requiring review.

**Referee.** A separate AI referee was given only a claim note, our earlier released proof text and this certificate, and was instructed to attack the claim. It checked the reduction against the live 82a definition and Doche's paper, checked every exact hypothesis, and wrote its own interval checker without reading or running our code. Verdict: **HOLDS WITH CAVEATS**. Its enclosure, B ∈ [0.251992340972008391240902200131, 0.251992340972008391240904220544], computed at 384 bits, lies inside ours. The caveat is provenance: the receipt's model string is “GPT-6-based Codex (exact serving-model ID not exposed)”. According to the launcher record the referee ran on GPT-6 Astra, a different model from the search, but the receipt cannot establish that. This is an AI review, not a second human party. [Referee report](https://github.com/rpinho/math-certificates/blob/a12c3622120c39af776902dbe49b6eff97a4d189/c82/degree104-joint/review/REFEREE.md), [replay receipt](https://github.com/rpinho/math-certificates/blob/a12c3622120c39af776902dbe49b6eff97a4d189/c82/degree104-joint/REPLAY.json).

**Independent replays.** Arhan Canli reports independent replays of all four versions of this PR, using his own code without reading or running ours; his replays disclose AI assistance (Claude, Anthropic). They cover the first filing, 0.252404806\* ([math-certificates @5461d49](https://github.com/rpinho/math-certificates/tree/5461d490552a518667c3fd3fceff33ebdb4d347c/c82/degree104-cvp)), the 5 November update, 0.2520179248\* ([@98208a4](https://github.com/rpinho/math-certificates/tree/98208a40e043e578d35183b418452f316112a658/c82/degree104-joint)), the round-6 final certificate, 0.2519964890\* ([@3be6b2f](https://github.com/rpinho/math-certificates/tree/3be6b2f133db43374ea30767b58c62ce2d39686a/c82/degree104-joint)), and this version, 0.2519923410\* ([@a12c362](https://github.com/rpinho/math-certificates/tree/a12c3622120c39af776902dbe49b6eff97a4d189/c82/degree104-joint)). Each of his enclosures lies below the printed bound ([comment on the first two](https://github.com/teorth/optimizationproblems/pull/330#issuecomment-6659835786) and [code](https://github.com/arhancanli/quantavane-replays/tree/7696576f41b418a5eacaed423b7b2078a521e26e/c82); [comment on the round-6 final](https://github.com/teorth/optimizationproblems/pull/330#issuecomment-6661349858) and [code](https://github.com/arhancanli/quantavane-replays/tree/2b7475fb6e9186973de44c1f2b0db4cb1d0ae6bf/c82); [comment on this version](https://github.com/teorth/optimizationproblems/pull/330#issuecomment-6667853184) and [code](https://github.com/arhancanli/quantavane-replays/tree/407182897083b3b3c2b642e2f8ac02ff92522f09/c82)).

Packet: [c82/degree104-joint](https://github.com/rpinho/math-certificates/tree/a12c3622120c39af776902dbe49b6eff97a4d189/c82/degree104-joint) ([certificate](https://github.com/rpinho/math-certificates/blob/a12c3622120c39af776902dbe49b6eff97a4d189/c82/degree104-joint/certificate.json), [verifier](https://github.com/rpinho/math-certificates/blob/a12c3622120c39af776902dbe49b6eff97a4d189/c82/degree104-joint/verify_best.py)).

**Verification level: L0** for the bound as a whole ([definitions](https://github.com/rpinho/math-certificates/blob/59eeb7097f806da05187b5f234445be3589204d4/VERIFICATION_LEVELS.md)). The search and verifier were written by the same AI agent lineage.

**Interaction with #280 and other open PRs.** The live merged page prints 0.2536331090204145 (0.2534449\*) as the upper entry. Open PRs changing 82a at this update: #242, #280 (0.2520079724\*) and #301 (0.253091834\*). The resulting PR is based on main 87b4ebbd and adds one row and one reference. If #280 or #301 merges first, keep their rows and references and append this one; in the README line, keep the lower entry and unasterisked upper value and replace only the parenthesized candidate with 0.2519923410\*. If #242 merges first, the README upper cell becomes 0.2534449 (0.2519923410\*). No claim is made that these PRs have merged.

Earlier packets for this PR: 0.252404806\* at [c82/degree104-cvp](https://github.com/rpinho/math-certificates/tree/5461d490552a518667c3fd3fceff33ebdb4d347c/c82/degree104-cvp), with its third-party notice; 0.2520179248\* at [c82/degree104-joint (round-6 checkpoint)](https://github.com/rpinho/math-certificates/tree/98208a40e043e578d35183b418452f316112a658/c82/degree104-joint); and 0.2519964890\* at [c82/degree104-joint (round-6 final)](https://github.com/rpinho/math-certificates/tree/3be6b2f133db43374ea30767b58c62ce2d39686a/c82/degree104-joint).

AI use and author review: Analysis and proof drafting by AI agents under my direction; I reviewed the results at summary level. AI agents also prepared the certificate, verifiers and submission text. This does not claim a line-by-line human verification.

**Models:** GPT-6.1 Sol via Codex (search, certificate, verifier, packaging); GPT-6 Astra via Codex, per the launcher record (separate AI referee and replay); Claude Code with Claude Opus 5.5 (coordination and PR text).
